title: Vague or Unassigned TODO Comments
pattern: `TODO` or `FIXME` comments without an explicit assignee, tracker reference, or descriptive action plan.
why_bad: Decay hazard. Unassigned, vague todo comments quickly lose context, are ignored by readers, and are untrackable by tooling, leaving permanent design flaws or hacks in the codebase.
detection: Comments matching patterns `TODO` or `FIXME` that do not contain an assignee name in parentheses (e.g., `TODO(username)`) or a tracking issue ID.
counterexample: `// TODO(alice): Refactor buffer allocation in issue #423 to avoid copy-on-write` - assigned, tracked, and actionable.
fix: Add an explicit assignee (username or email) and a reference to a tracking ticket or precise description of the required fix.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4 ("TODO Comments"); Steve McConnell, *Code Complete* (2004), Chapter 32.4 ("Marker in the Code").
